name: Do I need to prime a repaired ceiling patch before painting the whole ceiling?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to prime a repaired ceiling patch before painting the whole ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is highly recommended to prime a repaired ceiling patch before painting the entire ceiling. Primer serves several critical functions: it seals the repair material, prevents any stains or imperfections from bleeding through the new paint, and helps the new paint adhere evenly. Without priming, the repaired area might absorb paint differently than the surrounding ceiling, resulting in an inconsistent finish, known as 'flashing'. Maine Results, Inc. always primes repaired areas to ensure a uniform and professional paint job.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, prime a repaired ceiling patch before painting to seal the repair, prevent stains, ensure even paint absorption, and achieve a consistent finish.
